UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Neon Catch player profile storing referral code, earned shields, star shards, referral count, and cloud best score.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

referralCode.description: Unique uppercase alphanumeric referral code owned by this player.

referredByCode.description: Referral code redeemed by this player, if any.

referredByUid.description: UID of the player who referred this user, if any.

lastClaimedRedeemerUid.description: Most recent redeemer UID claimed by this referrer.

bonusShields.description: Available Bonus Start Shields (+1 extra starting heart per shield).

starShards.description: Total Star Shards earned via referrals.

ReferralCode.title: ReferralCode
ReferralCode.description: Public lookup record mapping a unique referral code to its owner UID and display name (no PII).

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the code owner.

ownerDisplayName.description: Display name of the code owner.

ReferralRedemption.title: ReferralRedemption
ReferralRedemption.description: Immutable record keyed by redeemerUid ensuring a user can redeem at most one referral code.

redeemerUid.description: UID of the user who redeemed the code.

referrerUid.description: UID of the friend who owns the referral code.

ClaimedReferral.title: ClaimedReferral
ClaimedReferral.description: Per-referrer ledger record preventing duplicate reward claims for a given redeemer.

redeemerName.description: Display name of the referred friend.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only player profile with referral code, rewards, and high score.

/users/{userId}/claimedReferrals/{redeem.description: Owner-only ledger of claimed referral rewards.

/referralCodes/{code}.description: Lookup index mapping referral code ID to owner UID and display name.

/referralRedemptions/{redeemerUid}.description: Append-only redemption records readable by redeemer or referrer.
